description: Every stationary subset of an infinite successor cardinal is partitioned into as many stationary pieces as the ambient cardinal.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.StationarySplitting.ulam_partition.{u} {κ : Cardinal.{u}} (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ)
  (S : Set (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.StationarySplitting.Carrier (Order.succ κ))) (hS : IsStationary S) :
  ∃ P,
    (∀ (i : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.StationarySplitting.Carrier (Order.succ κ)), IsStationary (P i)) ∧
      (Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)) ∧ ⋃ i, P i = S
